{{Quote|Looks like a few Tusken Raiders are camped out on the Canyon Dune Turn.|Fodesinbeed Annodue mentions Orr'UrRuuR'R and his companions during podracer commentary|audio=Fode-TuskenRaiders.flac|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Orr'UrRuuR'R''' was a [[Tusken Raider]] [[Gender|male]] who lived on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]], Orr'UrRuuR'R and several other Tuskens took up position on top of the [[Canyon Dune Turn]] portion of the [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[podracing]] course and fired on the [[podracer]]s passing by.

==Biography==
Orr'UrRuuR'R was a [[Tusken Raider]] [[Gender|male]] who lived as part of a [[Orr'UrRuuR'R's tribe|tribe]] that roamed the [[Jundland Wastes]] of their [[homeworld]] of [[Tatooine]]<ref name="Force Collection" /> in the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]].<ref name="Absolutely Everything">''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know]]''</ref> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Orr'UrRuuR'R was among a group of at least four Tuskens who fired from a cliff top at the [[Podracer (profession)|podracers]] competing in the<ref name="TPM" /> [[Boonta Eve Classic]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> race as the competitors passed through the [[Canyon Dune Turn]] portion of the course. During the first lap of the course, Orr'UrRuuR'R and the other Tusken Raiders huddled together to communicate before spreading out to fire on the podracers.<ref name="TPM" />

[[File:Tuskens_canyon.png|thumb|left|200px|Orr'UrRuuR'R shot at podracers in the Canyon Dune Turn.]]
The [[Troig]] commentators [[Fodesinbeed Annodue]]<ref name="Absolutely Everything" /> mentioned the Tuskens in their commentary of the race. Despite not taking out any of the vehicles, the Tuskens then cheered while raising their [[rifle]]s above their heads. When the podracers returned to the Canyon Dune Turn during the second lap, the racer [[Teemto Pagalies]]' vehicle was hit by a shot from one of the Tuskens and subsequently crashed.<ref name="TPM" />

==Personality and traits==
Orr'UrRuuR'R found his nomadic lifestyle among the Jundland Wastes' inhospitable [[desert]] terrain somewhat dull but enjoyed taking pot shots at podracers whenever they got the chance.<ref name="Force Collection" />

==Equipment==
Orr'UrRuuR'R wore a [[Color|brown]] [[robe]] and head wrap that completely covered their body. The Tusken Raider's outfit also included [[glove]]s, a [[bandolier]], and a [[belt]] of pouches. Orr'UrRuuR'R used<ref name="TPM" /> a [[cycler rifle]]<ref name="SWB">''[[Star Wars Battlefront]]''</ref> to fire on the podracers.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orr'UrRuuR'R appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], the character was identified by the [[Star Wars video games|mobile game]] ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'', which initially launched in [[2013]].<ref name="Force Collection" /> Although the launch of ''Force Collection'' predates<ref name="Force Collection release">{{SW|url=news/announcing-star-wars-force-collection|text=Announcing Star Wars: Force Collection|nolive=1}}</ref> the ''Star Wars'' canon reset of [[2014]],<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref> [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Leland Chee]] confirmed that the game was kept updated to fit with canon.<ref name="Twitter">{{Twitter|holocronkeeper|status/846807700482666496|[[Leland Chee]]|quote=I'm not gonna go through the trouble of changing them and I don't have any reason to believe currently that anyone would. […] On the off-chance that we DID have a current need to change any of these, we would have for Force Collection.|archivefile=File:Leland_Chee_Force_Collection.png}} — [[Leland Chee]] of the [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] has confirmed that [[in-universe]] information from ''[[Star Wars: Force Collection]]'' conforms with ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].</ref> The [[Orr'UrRuuR'R/Legends|character's]] name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, first appearing on a [https://web.archive.org/web/2001/http://decipher.com/youngjedi/cardlists/boontaevepodrace/dark/large/36orrurruurrtuskenraider.html card] in the [[2001]] [[Young Jedi Reflections|''Reflections'']] expansion set of the ''[[Young Jedi Collectible Card Game]]'' released by [[Decipher]]<ref name="YJCCG">{{YJCCG|set=Boonta Eve Podrace|cardname=Orr'UrRuuR'R|link=boontaevepodrace/dark/large/36orrurruurrtuskenraider.html}}</ref>
